Except as provided in paragraph (C) of this Article, this contract is deemed to incorporate any changes that are required by statute to be implemented during the term of this contract and any regulations implementing or interpreting such statutory provisions.
- B. - C. CMS agrees that it will not implement, other than at the beginning of a calendar year, regulations under 42 CFR Part 423 that impose new, significant regulatory requirements on PDP Sponsor. This provision does not apply to new requirements mandated by statute. [42 CFR § 423.516]
- D. If PDP Sponsor had a contract with CMS for Contract Year 2024 under the contract ID number designated above, this document is considered a renewal of the existing contract.
